rotation_note: Unattended-run override: NO rotating subset. All 3 core keywords plus the entire politics pool (34 keywords, grouped into geopolitics / policy_regulation / elections_public_opinion) are working keywords today (37 total). Day-of-year 319 sets ORDER only: group lead rotates so no group leads twice in a row (policy_regulation led 11-13, elections_public_opinion led 11-14, so geopolitics leads today, then policy_regulation, then elections_public_opinion); within each group the list starts at offset 319 % group_size in pool order (geopolitics 10 -> 9: 소버린 AI first; policy 15 -> 4: AI copyright lawsuit first; elections 9 -> 4: content provenance C2PA first). Queries were not checked with WebSearch (budget reserved for librarians); librarians should prefer outlet RSS/sitemap_news feeds over site: search for recency. Window: last brief was 2026-11-14, so items published 11-14 (after the prior harvest) through 11-15 are in scope. Context: Sunday 11-15 in Korea / Saturday 11-14 in the US and EU at harvest time — the thinnest official-output day of the week. Expect yield from Korean Sunday wire/IT-trade copy (연합뉴스, 전자신문, ZDNet Korea, 디지털투데이 — 과기정통부·개인정보위·방통위 weekend embargo releases for Monday, 국회 예산 심사·과방위 법안소위 schedule outcomes), Saturday US/EU wire copy (AP, POLITICO Europe weekend), think-tank/long-form posts dated 11-14 (Lawfare, Tech Policy Press, CSET, ChinaTalk, Rest of World) that report a NEW document, and court dockets with Friday-evening 11-13 orders that surfaced 11-14. Upcoming hooks — only official documents are new, skip previews: CCW 7th Review Conference Geneva opens Monday 11-16 (formal state working papers posted on the UNODA site are new; preview pieces are not); APEC Shenzhen US-China summit 11-18..19 (skip agenda previews); House closed briefing with Jensen Huang 11-18; Meta AI-scraping terms take effect 11-20; Delhi HC Kriti Sanon hearing 12-10. In scope: bills introduced/marked up, agency rules/bulletins, court rulings and filings, regulator enforcement, export-control actions, official after-action reports on AI-enabled interference, platform takedown reports. OUT of scope: who won, seat counts, polling, horse-race analysis, commentary without a new document. Neutrality rule from sources.json applies: report decisions/filings/releases, attribute contested claims, no partisan framing.
